messages.content: Make a video explaining how password reset works in our web app: the user says they forgot their password, the app looks up their account, emails them a one-time link, and the user opens it and chooses a new password.

I've drawn the password reset flow as a graph: the user asks for help, the web app looks up the account, sends a one-time link by email, and the user opens the link to save a new password. The Mermaid is above in the result, and the preview link is in the project panel.

Does this graph look right? Tell me if you want any nodes or labels changed. Once you approve it, I'll work out the story: who it's for, the one thing to remember, and the opening line.
The graph looks good. I approve it.
